_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Sparkflights deal cards with the destination photo, price, dates and a link to each fare page.

description: Search flight fares Sparkflights has already found and verified, ranked by cost per mile against each market's limit. Not a live fare search: an empty result means no current verified fare matches. Each result has the price text of its Sparkflights fare page; url, the fare page; route_url, the route page, which lists the route's live fares and price history; and feed_url, the route's JSON feed of new fares.

cabin.description: Cabin classes, one or more of: economy, premium_economy, business, first

depart_month.description: YYYY-MM, for example 2026-12: only deals whose first departure date is in that month

destination.description: Where the trip goes: an IATA airport code (NRT) for that airport, or a city for every airport the city's route pages cover: its name (Tokyo), a metro code (TYO), or its name with its country or state (London, UK; Portland, Maine)

destination_region.description: Destination regions, one or more of: africa, asia, europe, north_america, oceania, south_america

include_budget.description: Add budget/low-cost carrier deals (Spirit, Frontier, etc.) to the others. Default false — budget deals are on /flights/budget.

low_cost.description: true returns only budget/low-cost carrier deals; overrides include_budget

max_price.description: US dollars: only deals listed at or under this price

origin.description: Where the trip starts: an IATA airport code (JFK) for that airport, or a city for every airport the city's route pages cover: its name (New York), a metro code (NYC), or its name with its country or state (London, UK; Portland, Oregon)

origin_region.description: Departure regions, one or more of: africa, asia, europe, north_america, oceania, south_america. Default: the regions the deal board lists, or every region when origin is given

sort.description: Sort order: cpm (default; cost per mile against its market's CPM ceiling, lowest first) or recent (newest first; newest is the same)

name: search_deals
